title: Leslie Kean's list of ordinary explanations
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of Leslie Kean's list of ordinary explanations, about 2010 at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This is from her book UFOs, Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record.

plain: A researcher known as a skeptic, Michael Shermer, reads out a list of ordinary explanations for UFO sightings during a debate on a podcast. He says the list comes from a 2010 book by Leslie Kean called UFOs: Generals, Pilots, and Government Officials Go on the Record. He uses it to point out that even a book that takes UFOs seriously admits that most sightings have everyday causes.
